name: wirewalk.feed.list
description: List the public Wirewalk feed, newest publication first (post ID breaks ties). Each post shows its author, publication time, stable link, text and its reply, quote or repost relationship. Returns up to limit posts (default 20) and a next_cursor. A cursor keeps the result set fixed at the first page: posts published later, even at the same timestamp, appear only in a fresh call. A cursor that no longer matches its query or the feed is rejected. Only posts published at or before the current time are visible; an unknown post and a post not yet published get the same not_found response.

name: wirewalk.search
description: Search visible post text (the post's own text, image alt text and link titles and descriptions; case- and accent-insensitive, every query word must match the start of a word). Reposts carry no text of their own, so they match only filter-only searches; a query with no letters or digits is rejected. Optional exact author_id and kind filters and an inclusive since/until window (since must not be later than until). Newest publication first, with post ID breaking ties; paging works as in wirewalk.feed.list. Only posts published at or before the current time are visible; an unknown post and a post not yet published get the same not_found response.

name: wirewalk.post.get
description: Read one post with its author, publication time, stable link, the post it replies to, quotes or reposts, and the visible replies, quotes and reposts of it (oldest first). Only posts published at or before the current time are visible; an unknown post and a post not yet published get the same not_found response.

name: wirewalk.thread.get
description: Open the conversation around a post: the chain of posts it replies to (root first), the post itself and every visible reply below it, in conversation order with depth. Quotes start their own conversations. Opening a repost opens its source's conversation. Only posts published at or before the current time are visible; an unknown post and a post not yet published get the same not_found response.

name: wirewalk.account.get
description: Inspect a public account: display name, kind (person or organization), bio, location, join date, profile link, visible post count and its most recent visible posts (default 10).

name: wirewalk.bookmarks.list
description: List this reader's private bookmarks, most recently saved first. Other accounts never see them.

name: wirewalk.bookmarks.add
description: Bookmark a visible post for this reader. Bookmarking a post that is already bookmarked leaves one bookmark (changed: false). Returns only the post ID and bookmark status.

name: wirewalk.bookmarks.remove
description: Remove this reader's bookmark on a visible post. Removing a bookmark that does not exist changes nothing (changed: false).
